The Behenian stars

Fifteen fixed stars of traditional electional power. Tap one for its image, virtues, stone and plant, and upcoming favorable times.

15 stars

The mansions of the Moon

Twenty-eight stations of the Moon's monthly journey, each with its elections and talismanic image.

28 mansions

Elections after Agrippa; additions labeled Picatrix/Arabic. Where the two disagree, both are shown, never merged.

A note on honest reckoning. The Pleiades are a cluster; Alcyone is used as the computational point. Agrippa records a variant position for Aldebaran (25° Aries, after Hermes). Agrippa lists two wings of Corvus; tables compute with δ Corvi. His remark on the Sun's aspect to Arcturus is garbled in the text, and no election is built on it. Mansion spirit names of Picatrix are reserved for a later edition.

Enochian angels
